(Japanese: ２つのBURSTハート Two Burst Hearts) is the nineteenth chapter of the Pokémon RéBURST manga.

==Plot==
 
== Major events ==
Ryouga defeats Zengai with his new technique.
Rend is healed from his injuries.
Rend entrusts Ryouga with his Burst Heart.
Ryouga, Miruto, and Yappy say their goodbyes to Rend and his family.
